pull.title: MINOR: Refactor REST extension registration (#23150)
pull.body: Refactor the Connect REST extension registration logic so that REST extensions configured via rest.extension.classes are also registered on the admin listener's ResourceConfig when admin.listeners is set (CVE-2026-115644).

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

commit.message:
MINOR: Refactor REST extension registration (#23150)

Refactor the Connect REST extension registration logic so that REST
extensions configured via rest.extension.classes are also registered on
the admin listener's ResourceConfig when admin.listeners is set
(CVE-2026-115644).
